description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for a single model, "Our Joint Framework," and four LLM models—"ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude"—on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," ranges from 0 to 400 in increments of 50, marked with dashed grid lines, and the horizontal axis lists the five models in alphabetical order. The chart uses a legend to distinguish the "Our Joint Framework," represented by a solid green bar with a value of 77 seconds, from the "LLM Models," represented by solid light blue bars. The runtime values for each LLM model are explicitly labeled atop their respective bars: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The bars are not grouped or stacked but are presented individually along the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized or sorted in any particular order beyond their placement.
